2.69.13
Table.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.ToolTip element specifies a tooltip for a Table. The element can also be used to render
alternative text (alt text) that is specified as an alt attribute in an HTML report. The Table.ToolTip
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section
3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. If this element is not present, the value of the
element is interpreted as NULL.
Following is the parent element of the Table.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
